historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works' granting of a permit to alter the building at 1720-1728 Haight Street, one of the four commissioners present having voted to overrule.
The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the granting of a cabaret license for 1748 Haight Street.
A cabaret was at 1748 Haight Street.
The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Police Department and denied the cabaret license for 1748 Haight Street.
The City Planning Commission approved a planned unit development at the site, including two townhouse units in the rear yard and replacement of an existing self-service restaurant, 6-1.
An existing self-service restaurant stood on the site.
The City Planning Commission disapproved the project to allow a retail space at the ground floor over 2,500 square feet in area.
A 4-story over basement building containing 32 dwelling units and 14,200 gross square feet of commercial space stood at the property.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization to modify the conditions of approval to allow payment of an in-lieu affordable housing fee rather than provide on-site affordable housing.
A recently constructed mixed-use building stood at the property.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization to locate an approximately 4,600 square foot Financial Service within the ground floor of a recently constructed mixed-use building.
